column1: # OLED substitution table for the PDM UniFi theme (themes/pdm/theme-unifi.css).
# PDM keeps its operative palette in rgb() declarations and only names colors in
# hex inside comments, so the two kinds never collide and are listed separately.
# A hex-only table (the PVE recipe) silently misses every declaration here.
# Tonal rungs: neutral, neutral-alt and secondary collapse onto one grayscale
# Accent and secondary text, matching the PVE OLED values.
